title: 2 Feature Requests  AOD & Alarms
body:
Hi,

1st: Is it possible to show the full Xdrip Notification Text (sugar level + trent) on the AOD for AMOLED devices not only the xdrip icon? 

Normaly all new app icons of apps having a notification coming in are shown next to each other in one line, but as soon as i play a song, the full song and Artist name is shown in a new line. So there must be a way to access the aod.

2nd: is it possible to outsource the alarms into a 2nd app.  e. g.  "Xdrip_alarm", or is there a setting for? 

Use Case: you could change the Notification Settings in Android for these two apps separately. So you could deny the steady xdrip notification on your home and lock screen but allowing the alarms.
